'''Lizard in the Thornbush''' is a [[sword form]]. This form has been used by a swordsman against single and multiple opponents. The movement of the form ends on one knee.{{ref/book|2|19}}

==In practice==
[[Rand al'Thor]] used this form to cut through two [[Trolloc]]s after stealing back the [[Horn of Valere]] from [[Padan Fain]]. 
{{quote|Two more Trollocs, wolf and ram, gleaming teeth and curling horns. Lizard in the Thornbush. He rose smoothly from one knee as the second toppled, horns almost brushing his shoulder.|Rand's thoughts when using the form.}}
Either [[Galadedrid Damodred]] or [[Eamon Valda]] used this form during their duel. The other person tried [[Lightning of Three Prongs]].{{ref/book|11|p}}
